description: This file defines a Java Swing toolbar class 'TableToolBar' which provides UI controls for interacting with tables in the RomRaider project. It includes buttons, combo boxes, and related logic for table operations such as scaling, multiplying, setting values, and rendering options. It manages the toolbar state based on the selected table and provides event handlers for user interactions.

classes.name: TableToolBar
classes.description: A Swing toolbar providing controls for table operations in the RomRaider tuning software.

methods.name: updateIcons
methods.description: Loads and scales toolbar icons according to user settings.

methods.name: rescaleImageIcon
methods.description: Rescales an ImageIcon by a specified scale percentage.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected table from the active editor window.

methods.name: updateTableToolBar
methods.description: Updates the toolbar UI to reflect the current selected table.

methods.name: updateToolbarIncrementDecrementValues
methods.description: Updates the fine and coarse increment values based on the selected table's scale.

methods.name: toggleTableToolBar
methods.description: Enables or disables toolbar controls based on the current table selection and type.

methods.name: setScales
methods.description: Populates the scale selection combo box with available scales.

methods.name: mouseClicked
methods.description: Handles click events on toolbar buttons to perform specific table operations.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the real value of the current table based on user input.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies current table values by a user-specified factor.

methods.name: incrementFine
methods.description: Increments table values by a fine adjustment amount.

methods.name: decrementFine
methods.description: Decrements table values by a fine adjustment amount.

methods.name: incrementCoarse
methods.description: Increments table values by a coarse adjustment amount.

methods.name: decrementCoarse
methods.description: Decrements table values by a coarse adjustment amount.

methods.name: enable3d
methods.description: Initiates a 3D rendering of the current table data.

methods.name: colorCells
methods.description: Colors the cells of the current table.

methods.name: refreshCompare
methods.description: Refreshes the comparison data between tables.

methods.name: setCoarseValue
methods.description: Sets the current coarse adjustment value.

methods.name: setFineValue
methods.description: Sets the current fine adjustment value.

methods.name: focusSetValue
methods.description: Focuses input to set a specific value.

methods.name: setInputMap
methods.description: Sets key bindings for toolbar controls.

methods.name: newGraphData
methods.description: Receives new data point for 3D graph rendering (not fully implemented).

methods.name: selectStateChange
methods.description: Handles selection state changes in 3D table visualization.

methods.name: getSelectedTable
methods.description: Returns the currently selected table.
